questions.question: What is the primary function of the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) within a CPU?
options: Performing arithmetic and logical operations.
Managing virtual memory pages.
Storing program instructions.
Generating clock signals.
Controlling data flow between peripheral devices.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic typically associated with a Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC) architecture?
options: Complex instructions that perform multiple operations.
Variable-length instruction formats.
A large number of addressing modes.
A relatively small, uniform set of instructions, often single-cycle.
Extensive microprogramming for instruction decoding.

questions.question: In synchronous digital IC design, what is the primary challenge addressed by Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) techniques?
options: Minimizing power consumption in clock networks.
Ensuring proper data synchronization between circuits operating at different clock frequencies or phases.
Reducing the physical area occupied by clock buffers.
Preventing latch-up conditions in mixed-signal designs.
Optimizing the fan-out of clock signals for timing closure.

questions.question: Which phenomenon in integrated circuit interconnects describes the mass transport of metal atoms under the influence of an electric current, leading to voids or hillocks and potentially causing open or short circuits over time?
options: Process variation
Electromigration
Hot carrier injection
Negative bias temperature instability (NBTI)
Dielectric breakdown

questions.question: What is the fundamental purpose of using a Hardware Description Language (HDL) like VHDL or Verilog in digital IC design?
options: To write device drivers for operating systems.
To simulate power consumption in analog circuits.
To describe the behavior and structure of digital electronic circuits.
To compile high-level programming languages into machine code.
To design graphical user interfaces for embedded systems.
